name: The Joule Dallas
insider_take: Downtown Dallas glamour meets contemporary art in this converted 1920s neo-Gothic landmark that houses one of the city's most impressive private art collections.
whats_special: The Joule's iconic cantilevered rooftop pool extends 8 feet beyond the building's edge, offering swimmers a thrilling perspective 10 stories above Main Street. The hotel showcases museum-quality contemporary art throughout, including works by Kaws and Andy Warhol, while the original 1927 Dallas National Bank vault now serves as a dramatic private dining room.
pro_tip: Book a sunset swim at the rooftop pool for the ultimate Instagram shot, then head to CBD Provisions downstairs for their famous weekend brunch featuring locally-sourced Texas ingredients.
dont_miss: The nearby Dallas Arts District is the largest contiguous urban arts district in the US, just blocks away. Take the complimentary Tesla house car service to explore Dealey Plaza, the historic West End, or catch a game at the American Airlines Center, all within minutes of the hotel.
pros: Iconic downtown Dallas location in historic landmark building
Distinctive contemporary art collection and bold design aesthetic
Rooftop pool with stunning city skyline views
Award-winning Charlie Palmer at The Joule restaurant
cons: Urban setting may lack traditional hotel tranquility
